conclusion: The Lineups API field id is a Lineups entity identifier, not a Dunkest player-profile ID. Numeric overlap with the profile catalogue is not sufficient evidence: this capture has 335 overlapping numeric IDs but 0 same-player matches at those IDs. Do not use Lineups id to query /api/player/games. Resolve historical player-game IDs only from the official profile catalogue or a verified profile URL.
policy: No Lineups entity ID is written into the official Dunkest player ID field.
Names matched to profile slugs are a separate matching dimension.
Unmatched rookies remain unresolved until a profile ID is published or an explicit official cross-reference is available.
